newsitem.title: USA: Air Force releases names of missing airmen.
newsitem.headline: Air Force releases names of missing airmen.

text.p: The Air Force Saturday released the names of 10 airmen missing after an HC-130 Hercules transport plane crashed into the Pacific Ocean off California.
Capt. Robert Schott, 36, West Linn, Ore.
Lt. Col. John Keyes, 46, Troutdale, Ore.
Senior Master Sgt. Robert Roberts, 47, Milwaukie, Ore.
Technical Sgt. David McCauley, 35, Gresham, Ore.
Staff Sgt. James Johnson, 27, Brush Prairie, Wash.
Staff Sgt. Marvin Forrest, 48, Vancouver, Wash.
Staff Sgt. Ronald Garner Jr. 30, Silverton, Ore.
Staff Sgt. Jonathan Leonard, 47, Tigard, Ore.
